flagged.location: Definition, initial-law clause and q=0 branch before the construction-filtration clause
flagged.evidence: The Definition says “Fix an initial probability vector ν on E” and “Y₀∼ν” without specifying νᵢ≥0, ∑ᵢνᵢ=1, or P(Y₀=i)=νᵢ. Its q=0 branch defines constant X but not N, while the later common clause defines Fₜ=σ(Nₛ,Xₛ:0≤s≤t). The existence proof’s separate assignment Nₜ=0 does not supply that missing part of this Definition.

The clause says “For probability measures μₙ, μ on (Ω,C), local weak convergence … means that (π_F)_*μₙ(B)→(π_F)_*μ(B)” but does not state the unit-mass condition or define the pushforward value as μ(π_F⁻¹(B)). Its only dependency, def-csm-finite-range-lattice-interaction, defines lattice interactions and supplies neither measure nor pushforward definitions.

flagged.location: Definition, paragraph defining the vague topology
flagged.evidence: The Definition makes continuity of ξ↦∫f dξ the topology-defining condition, but neither this item nor a dependency defines integration against ξ; deps is empty. The item defines ξ(B) by counting listed points, but does not give the finite-sum formula for ∫f dξ. Thus the functional used to define the topology is not made explicit.

flagged.location: Example, first sentence defining the probability on Ωₙ
flagged.evidence: The Example equips Ωₙ with “uniform probability Pₙ” without specifying Pₙ({π})=1/(2n)! for each bijection. Proof 1.1 uses the equal mass of bijections to count the (2n−1)! maps with a prescribed image; the atom formula is absent.

flagged.location: Proof 3.1, conditional expectation of 2 Mᵤ ΔM and subdivision estimate
flagged.evidence: Proof 3.1 sets the conditional expectation of 2MᵤΔM to zero and then uses the tower property to return the subdivision bounds to Fₛ. The cited thm-basic-algebra-and-order-properties-of-conditional-expectation states linearity and order properties, not E[MᵤΔM|Fᵤ]=MᵤE[ΔM|Fᵤ] or the tower identity. The exact suppliers thm-taking-out-what-is-known and thm-tower-property-of-conditional-expectation are not declared or cited for these uses; both steps can also be supplied locally.

flagged.location: Statement, first paragraph defining P_X, Q_X, P_{Y|x}, and Q_{Y|x}
flagged.evidence: The Statement calls P and Q “probability vectors” and names their first-coordinate marginals and conditional vectors without coordinate conditions or formulas. The direct KL dependency likewise only says “probability vectors” and does not supply their definition. The chain rule and equality claim depend on these objects; for example, the item does not specify P_X(x)=∑ᵧP(x,y) or the conditional coordinates P(x,y)/P_X(x) when P_X(x)>0.

After deriving the conditional law given Gₛ, the proof says “conditioning down to Fₛ gives the required identity.” This uses the tower property for Fₛ⊆Gₛ and an integrable indicator. The exact supplier thm-tower-property-of-conditional-expectation states the nested-sigma-algebra identity, but it is absent from this item’s deps and cited facts.
